answer: Proposed issuer-cut rule: a sparrow key earns only with a whisper receipt signed by a licensed settlement operator. A bridge registry permits one rewarded key per operator per epoch; independent auditors verify operator licenses, and validators slash its posted guarantee if it double-signs. A farm can share its model and rent slots, but k clones require k distinct licensed operators, not k receipts from one; each extra slot consumes an operator's sole paid capacity. Borrowing capital cannot duplicate a license, though operator collusion and centralization remain risks.
